title: 2019年12月 第1套
passage: 牡丹花色艳丽，形象高雅，象征着和平与繁荣，因而在中国被称为“花中之王”。中国许多地方都培育和种植牡丹。千百年来，创造了许多诗歌和绘画赞美牡丹。唐代时期，牡丹在皇家园林普遍种植并被誉为国花，因而特别风行。十世纪时，洛阳古城成为牡丹栽培中心，而且这一地位一直保持到今天。现在，成千上万的国内游客蜂拥到洛阳参加一年一度的牡丹节，欣赏洛阳牡丹独特之美，同时探索九朝古都的历史。
reference: The peony, boasting bright colors and an elegant appearance, is a symbol of peace and prosperity and thus recognized as “king of the flowers” in China. Peonies are bred and grown in many parts of the country. Over the centuries, numerous poems and paintings have been created to praise the flower. Peonies were particularly popular during the Tang Dynasty, when they were extensively cultivated in the imperial gardens and praised as the national flower. In the tenth century, the ancient city of Luoyang became the center for peony cultivation, a position it still holds today. Nowadays, thousands of tourists from home and abroad flock to Luoyang for the annual Peony Festival to both admire the unique beauty of the city's peonies and explore the history of the ancient capital of nine dynasties.
points: 第一句：次要信息“花色艳丽、形象高雅”用现在分词短语 boasting bright colors and an elegant appearance 作定语，与主干以逗号隔开；“象征着……被称为……”用并列谓语 is a symbol of... and is thus recognized as...。
第二句：汉语无主句转译为被动句 Peonies are bred and grown in many parts of the country，一般现在时表常态。
第三句：同为无主句，转译为被动；“了”提示动作已完成，用现在完成时 have been created；to praise the flower 作目的状语。
第四句：时间词“唐代时期”提示一般过去时；“因而特别风行”处理为主干 Peonies were particularly popular，原因小句用 when 引导的定语从句补充唐代的具体情况。
第五句：小句1译为主干 became the center for peony cultivation；小句2与“中心”所指相同，用同位语 a position it still holds today 处理，it 回指 Luoyang。
第六句：主干为 tourists flock to Luoyang；“参加牡丹节”用 for the annual Peony Festival 表目的；后两个动作并列，用不定式 to both admire... and explore... 作目的状语。
source: 2019年12月CET6题+解+音频/03、答案解析/2019.12英语六级考试解析第1套.pdf
